name: copycode
description: Chrome extension: copy any block of a web page as a Next.js + shadcn/ui + Tailwind component, JSX, HTML, an image, or layers for Figma and Paper.

scripts.zip: rm -f copycode.zip && zip -r copycode.zip manifest.json background.js tailwind-data.js shadcn-data.js tailwind.js vector.js content.js icons
